top_signals.title: Danantara: Committed to Deploying Another $5B This Year
top_signals.summary:
Danantara CIO Pandu Sjahrir says Indonesia’s state sovereign wealth fund is committed to deploying another $5 billion this year. He speaks with Haslinda Amin from the sidelines of '2026 Milken Institute Asia Summit'.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
